title: Rayne's Craftables
description: Adds crafting recipes to make more items renewable
body:
This datapack adds crafting recipes for a variety of items, most of which are nonrenewable in vanilla survival.

Notable additions include:
* Multiple stone types
* Pottery Sherd copying
* Heavy Core
* Gunpowder (now renewable in Peaceful)

The full list of features can be found in the "features.txt" file inside the datapack.

<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/JsMHSC5lnbY" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>

The recipes are not visible in the crafting book until after they are used for the first time, so I suggest using Just Enough Items ( https://modrinth.com/mod/jei ) to view them.

This datapack is a spiritual continuation to my discontinued pack "Craft More Stones!" ( https://modrinth.com/datapack/craft-more-stones! ) which functioned the same but only had recipes for stone-type blocks.

Spinoff Packs:
* Rayne's Illegal Craftables ( https://modrinth.com/datapack/raynes-illegal-craftables )
